title: Neutral-pronoun control and accuracy check for twin averaging
description: Add a neutral-pronoun arm (they, and blanked) beside he and she on the bios task to show which direction the pronoun bias runs, and score the twin-averaged verdict against the corpus occupation label to check that removing the variable does not cost accuracy. Prompted by a reader asking whether stripping sex creates more equal distributions. Pre-register before any run; Laya only.

comments.author: home
comments.text:
Feature: Pronoun control arms
  Scenario: Neutral pronouns show the direction of the bias
    Given the same 2000 bios with the pronoun set to he, she, they and blanked
    When Laya answers paralegal or attorney for each arm
    Then the neutral verdict rate is reported beside he and she with intervals
  Scenario: Twin averaging does not cost accuracy
    Given the twin-averaged verdict for each bio
    When it is scored against the corpus occupation label
    Then accuracy is reported beside the single-pronoun verdicts

right_now_summary: The team is preparing neutral-pronoun tests and an accuracy check for twin averaging.
